description: Original ACARS cabin announcements converted to structured speech templates. Only text is spoken.

time_of_day.description: Spoken time of day: morning, afternoon, or evening.

airline_name.description: Airline name as it should be spoken.

flight_number.description: Flight number as it should be spoken.

destination.description: Destination name as it should be spoken.

flight_time.description: Approximate flight duration in spoken form.

cruising_altitude.description: Cruising altitude in feet in spoken form.

weather_description.description: Brief weather description appropriate to the announcement.

arrival_time.description: Expected arrival time in spoken form.

emergency_exit_locations.description: Aircraft-specific emergency exit locations, in spoken form.

life_vest_location.description: Aircraft-specific life-vest location, in spoken form.

geographic_location.description: Current geographic location; source says to use this only if interesting and known.

remaining_flight_time.description: Approximate time remaining in spoken form.

temperature.description: Temperature with units in spoken form.

announcements.title: Boarding Complete / Welcome Aboard
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Good {{time_of_day}} ladies and gentlemen. On behalf of {{airline_name}} and our entire crew, we'd like to welcome you aboard flight {{flight_number}} with service to {{destination}}. We are currently finishing up the boarding process, and our captain {{captain_name}} will be making an announcement shortly with more details about our flight. Please ensure all carry-on luggage is stowed securely in the overhead compartments or under the seat in front of you. For those seated in exit rows, please review the safety card and be familiar with your responsibilities. Thank you for choosing to fly with us today.

announcements.title: Boarding Complete / Welcome Aboard
announcements.speaker: captain
announcements.text: Good {{time_of_day}} ladies and gentlemen, this is your Captain, {{captain_name}}, speaking from the flight deck. On behalf of the entire crew, I'd like to extend a warm welcome aboard {{airline_name}} flight {{flight_number}} to {{destination}}. We have a flight time of approximately {{flight_time}} and will be cruising at an altitude of {{cruising_altitude}} feet. The weather en route is expected to be {{weather_description}}. We anticipate an on-time arrival in {{destination}} at approximately {{arrival_time}}. Please make yourselves comfortable, and our flight attendants will be coming through the cabin to ensure everyone is ready for departure. We thank you for flying with us and look forward to a smooth journey.

announcements.title: Security Briefing
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, your safety is our top priority. Please direct your attention to the flight attendants for a brief demonstration of the safety features of this aircraft. Ensure your seatbelt is securely fastened by inserting the metal fitting into the buckle and tightening the strap. To release, lift the top of the buckle. Please keep your seatbelt fastened low and tight across your hips whenever you are seated, as we may encounter unexpected turbulence. There are {{emergency_exit_count}} emergency exits on this aircraft, located {{emergency_exit_locations}}. Please take a moment to locate the nearest exit to you. Note that the closest exit may be behind you. In the unlikely event of a loss of cabin pressure, oxygen masks will deploy from the compartment above your seat. Pull a mask towards you to start the flow of oxygen, place it over your nose and mouth, and secure it with the elastic strap. If you are traveling with a child or someone needing assistance, please secure your own mask first before assisting others. Life vests are located {{life_vest_location}}. Please refer to the safety information card in your seat pocket for instructions on how to use it. Federal Aviation Regulations require compliance with all lighted signs, posted placards, and crew instructions. Smoking, including e-cigarettes, is prohibited on this aircraft, including in the lavatories. Tampering with, disabling, or destroying lavatory smoke detectors is a federal offense. Please review the safety information card in your seat pocket for more detailed information specific to this aircraft type. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to ask a flight attendant. Thank you for your attention.

announcements.title: Prepare for Departure
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we are now preparing for departure. Please ensure your seatbacks are in their full upright position, your tray tables are stowed, and all carry-on items are placed securely in the overhead bins or under the seat in front of you. Please also ensure your seatbelt is securely fastened. All portable electronic devices larger than a cell phone should be turned off and stowed at this time. Smaller devices, such as cell phones, must be set to airplane mode. Thank you for your cooperation.

announcements.title: Prepare for Departure
announcements.speaker: captain
announcements.text: Flight attendants, please prepare the cabin for departure.
announcements.note: Interphone/internal crew communication; not a passenger announcement.

announcements.title: Prepare for Departure
announcements.speaker: captain
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, this is the Captain again. We have completed all pre-departure checks and are ready for pushback. We expect a brief taxi to the runway and a smooth takeoff. Please ensure your seatbelts are fastened and remain seated with your tray tables stowed and seatbacks upright until we have reached our cruising altitude and the Captain has turned off the fasten seatbelt sign. Thank you.
announcements.note: Source indicates this occurs shortly after the crew call.

announcements.title: You Can Now Use Portable Electronics
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, the Captain has turned off the fasten seatbelt sign. You are now permitted to use approved portable electronic devices. Larger devices, such as laptops, may now be used. Please be mindful of your fellow passengers and keep the volume of your devices at a low level or use headphones. As a reminder, cellular service is not available at this altitude. If you are using a device, please ensure it is in airplane mode. The fasten seatbelt sign may be turned on again if we anticipate turbulence, so we recommend keeping your seatbelt loosely fastened whenever you are seated. Thank you.

announcements.title: Message from Captain
announcements.speaker: captain
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, this is the Captain speaking. Just wanted to give you a brief update on our flight progress. We are currently cruising smoothly at {{cruising_altitude}} feet over {{geographic_location}}. We have approximately {{remaining_flight_time}} remaining until our arrival in {{destination}}. The weather ahead is looking {{weather_update}}. We'll keep you informed of any significant changes. In the meantime, sit back, relax, and enjoy the rest of your flight.

announcements.title: Final Descent into Destination
announcements.speaker: captain
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, this is the Captain. We have now begun our final descent into {{destination}}. We expect to land at approximately {{arrival_time}}. The weather in {{destination}} is currently {{weather_description}} with a temperature of {{temperature}}. The fasten seatbelt sign has been turned on and must remain fastened for your safety until we are parked at the gate and the sign is turned off. The flight attendants will be coming through the cabin to prepare for arrival. Thank you.

announcements.title: Final Descent into Destination
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, as the Captain announced, we have started our descent into {{destination}}. Please ensure your seatbelts are securely fastened. We ask that you return your seatbacks to their full upright position, stow your tray tables, and ensure all carry-on items are secured. Please also turn off and stow all portable electronic devices larger than a cell phone at this time. Smaller devices should remain in airplane mode. Thank you.

announcements.title: Prepare for Landing / Cross Check
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we are now on our final approach to {{destination}}. Please ensure your seatbelts are securely fastened, your seatbacks are upright, and your tray tables are stowed. All carry-on items should be stowed under the seat in front of you or in the overhead bin. Please also ensure the area around your feet is clear.

announcements.title: Prepare for Landing / Cross Check
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Cabin crew, prepare for landing and crosscheck.
announcements.note: Internal crew communication; not a passenger announcement.

announcements.title: Prepare for Landing / Cross Check
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.note: Source indicates this follows completion of the internal crosscheck.

announcements.title: Welcome to Destination
announcements.speaker: captain
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, on behalf of {{airline_name}} and the entire crew, welcome to {{destination}}. The local time is {{local_time}}. We have arrived at Gate {{gate_number}}. For your safety, please remain seated with your seatbelt fastened until the Captain has turned off the fasten seatbelt sign. Please be careful when opening overhead compartments as items may have shifted during the flight. We hope you enjoyed your flight with us today.

announcements.title: Welcome to Destination
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to {{destination}}. Please remain seated with your seatbelt fastened until the Captain has turned off the fasten seatbelt sign. When deplaning, please take all of your personal belongings with you. Be cautious when opening the overhead bins, as items may have moved. We appreciate you flying with {{airline_name}} and hope to see you again soon.

announcements.title: Deboarding Message
announcements.speaker: flight_attendant
announcements.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we have arrived at the gate and the Captain has turned off the fasten seatbelt sign. You may now carefully stand up and gather your belongings. Please use caution when opening the overhead compartments. Please allow those seated in front of you to deplane first. Please ensure you have all your personal items with you before leaving the aircraft. On behalf of {{airline_name}} and the crew, we thank you for flying with us and wish you a wonderful {{farewell_time}} in {{destination}} or at your final destination.
